Goal! Barcelona 2, Alaves 0. Fermín López (Barcelona) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the top left corner. Assisted by Lamine Yamal.
Carlos Protesoni (Alaves) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Pedri (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Barcelona 3, Alaves 0. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Fermín López with a through ball.
Goal! Barcelona 4, Alaves 0. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by João Cancelo.
Ángel Pérez (Alaves) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Barcelona 4, Alaves 0.
Substitution, Barcelona. Marc Bernal replaces Pedri.
Substitution, Alaves. Toni Martínez replaces Carlos Protesoni.
Substitution, Alaves. Pablo Ibáñez replaces Denis Suárez.
Substitution, Alaves. Aitor Mañas replaces Abde Rebbach.
João Cancelo (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Pablo Ibáñez (Alaves) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Barcelona. Alejandro Balde replaces João Cancelo.
Substitution, Barcelona. Gabriel Jesus replaces Raphinha.

Goal! Barcelona 5, Alaves 0. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Gabriel Jesus with a through ball.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Substitution, Barcelona. Anthony Gordon replaces Lamine Yamal.
Substitution, Alaves. Hugo Novoa replaces Ángel Pérez.
Substitution, Alaves. Mariano Díaz replaces Lucas Boyé.
Goal! Barcelona 6, Alaves 0. Anthony Gordon (Barcelona) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Rodri with a through ball.
Substitution, Barcelona. Gerard Martín replaces Frenkie de Jong.
Goal! Barcelona 6, Alaves 1. Mariano Díaz (Alaves) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Gerard Martín (Barcelona).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Second Half ends, Barcelona 6, Alaves 1.
